teams.detail: Agreed to be sold to the Khosla family for an NFL-record $9.612 billion, pending a late-August owner vote. RB Zach Charbonnet is 'progressing well' from his torn ACL ahead of a late-July checkup. Training camp public practices begin July 25 in Renton.

Fell to the Knicks 86-75 in Vegas Summer League Monday — Chaz Lanier led Detroit with 24 points on 8-for-12 shooting from three. Detroit is 2-3 in the tournament after beating Cleveland 103-94 two days earlier. Next: vs. Suns, Wednesday 7/15, 6 PM ET, the Pistons' Summer League finale.

Enter the break at 48-49 — a Wild Card spot, one game behind AL West-leading Texas (49-47) — after snapping a five-game skid with an 8-2 win over Tampa Bay Saturday. LF Randy Arozarena represents Seattle at tonight's All-Star Game in Philadelphia (8 PM ET). Regular season resumes this weekend.

RB Jordan Washington remains on track for a late-July return from the spring injury that carted him off the practice field. Jedd Fisch enters year three with a Big Ten slate featuring road trips to USC, Purdue, Nebraska, Michigan State and Oregon; the season opens September 5 at home against Washington State in the Apple Cup.

UW is one of four finalists for 5-star guard Dylan Mingo as Danny Sprinkle rebuilds through the portal following Zoom Diallo's departure. International signee Nikola Dzepina has joined the program; F Hannes Steinbach, the 14th pick in June's NBA Draft, begins his rookie season with Charlotte.

headlines.headline: Grizzlies trade Ja Morant to the Trail Blazers as Summer League rolls on in Vegas
headlines.detail: Former All-Star guard Ja Morant is headed from Memphis to Portland in a trade, one of the offseason's biggest moves, while the Wizards finalize a three-year, $17.6 million sign-and-trade for wing Khris Middleton. In Vegas, the Rockets held the 76ers to 31.1% shooting in a 90-64 win to open Tuesday's Summer League slate.

headlines.headline: Seahawks sale to the Khosla family valued at an NFL-record $9.612 billion awaits owner vote
headlines.detail: The Estate of Paul G. Allen agreed to sell the Super Bowl-champion Seahawks to a group led by the Khosla family for a reported $9.612 billion, shattering the prior NFL record of $6.05 billion for the Washington Commanders in 2023. The deal needs approval from at least 24 of 32 owners at a special meeting expected in late August.

headlines.headline: LSU headlines the transfer portal cycle with eight top-100 signees as the window closes
headlines.detail: College football's 2026 transfer portal window has effectively closed, with LSU signing eight of ESPN's top 100 transfer prospects under new coach Lane Kiffin, including the No. 1-ranked tackle Jordan Seaton and edge rusher Princewill Umanmielen. Penn State's new staff brought nearly 40 transfers from Iowa State.

headlines.headline: NCAA men's tournament will expand to 76 teams for 2026-27 as recruiting reshuffles the top classes
headlines.detail: The NCAA confirmed the Division I men's basketball tournament will grow from 68 to 76 teams starting in 2026-27. On the recruiting trail, Texas jumped into the top-five class rankings after 6-10 forward Marcus Spears reclassified to sign with the Longhorns, while Kansas landed top overall prospect Tyran Stokes.
